transcript.text: Correction to the definition I gave you earlier. The 'primary region' is actually the region with the highest NET revenue (amount minus discount over completed orders), not gross. Please update your saved knowledge so future answers use this corrected definition.

args.intent: primary region definition net revenue gross revenue

args.content: Correction: The 'primary region' is the region (customers.region, joined via orders.customer_id -> customers) with the highest NET revenue, not gross. Net revenue = SUM(orders.amount - orders.discount) over completed orders only (orders.status = 'completed') in memory.bench.orders. This supersedes the prior gross-revenue-based definition. Recompute by filtering orders to status='completed', joining to customers on customer_id, grouping by customers.region, summing (amount - discount), and taking the region with the max total. Use this definition consistently for 'primary region' on the orders/customers datasets.

transcript.text: Saved the correction as a new schema_entity insight (linked to `memory.bench.orders` and `memory.bench.customers`), which automatically superseded the old gross-revenue-based "primary region" insight — so future recall will surface the corrected net-revenue definition.
